acceptance: Derive identity and canonical event bytes inside the trusted device boundary.
Bind preview, selected identity, full operation and one-use approval; reject mutation, replay, cancellation races and unreviewed metadata.
Bound resource use and handle long/hostile Unicode content without misleading truncation.
An independently computed event ID and signature verifier agree for positive and adversarial vectors.

This task establishes portable authorization/parser semantics with host-executable negative tests. Physical UI/input and peripheral isolation remain each profile's actual-device acceptance; do not wait for all boards to implement the state machine.

acceptance_mapping.limit: Portable negative tests only; physical UI/input/peripheral isolation remains each actual profile task.

case_id_note: S03-0..S03-4 in requirements refer to zero-based unchanged task acceptance indexes; local case IDs such as P01 are test IDs, not task lifecycle records.

cases.arrange: Disposable scalars 1, 3 and n-3; wrong caller descriptor public key; zero/n intake negative controls.
cases.actions: Consume each S02 secret; compare derived x-only key with pinned BIP340 oracle; replace selected account while review is pending.
cases.expected: Known keys match independent derivation; descriptors cannot choose author. Raw caller buffer remains cleared; no public secret getter/Clone. Account replacement invalidates old review even for same x-only pubkey.
cases.oracle: BIP340 Public Key Generation + pinned reference.py; n-3 gives same x-only key but separate account generation.
cases.baseline_strategy: Capture current select_session_account accepting a wrong but syntactically valid descriptor pubkey with source_public_key_proof_verified=false; do not misreport it as signing today.

cases.arrange: Valid request plus duplicates at envelope/params/template layers, including kind versus k\u0069nd and params versus p\u0061rams.
cases.actions: Feed raw bytes to standalone parser, serial and QR adapters; permute known member order; append second object/NUL/nonspace; test trailing comma and missing comma.
cases.expected: Each duplicate/unknown/missing/trailing/malformed input rejects before any approval/backend call. Unique reordered objects decode to the same operation.
cases.oracle: Independent strict Python object_pairs_hook detects decoded duplicate names; RFC8259 grammar and exact required-member sets.
cases.baseline_strategy: Reproduce duplicate-kind overwrite and protocol trailing object acceptance on baseline functions; save exact raw input and result.

cases.arrange: Values 0,1,65535,65536,-1,-0,+1,01,1.0,1e0,NaN,Infinity,2^53-1,2^53,u64 overflow; booleans/null/string types.
cases.actions: Place at version/kind/created_at with each other field valid. Parse syntactically valid unsupported kinds separately from authorization.
cases.expected: kind 0..65535 only; timestamp 0..2^53-1 only; canonical unsigned-decimal spellings only. Valid other kinds parse but never receive S03 authority; malformed number rejected by parser.
cases.oracle: Independent lexeme-aware parse_int callback and explicit type/range rules, not Python float coercion.
cases.baseline_strategy: Reproduce kind65536 and leading-zero created_at acceptance in baseline parser; preserve unambiguous controls.

cases.arrange: Valid raw/escaped BMP, U+1F600 surrogate pair, combining e+U+0301; invalid UTF8 overlong NUL, surrogate UTF8, >U+10FFFF, truncated sequence; lone/reversed surrogate escapes; raw C0.
cases.actions: Exercise standalone and both adapter paths; compare valid escaped/raw equivalents.
cases.expected: Malformed inputs reject without replacement/deletion; valid scalar strings identical after decoding. Composed and decomposed strings remain distinct.
cases.oracle: UTF8 standard decoder + explicit reject-surrogate sweep in independent Python; hand-selected hostile octets.
cases.baseline_strategy: Confirm existing surrogate rejection retained; save direct parser UTF8 intake gaps if observable rather than assume all adapters identical.

cases.arrange: Tiny empty-content operation plus each control, slash, quote, backslash, U+2028/U+2029, supplementary scalar, NUL, composed/decomposed text; tags with duplicate ordered values.
cases.actions: Derive fixture identity inside owner; serialize/hash with core and independently from semantic inputs.
cases.expected: Exact canonical byte equality and 32-byte SHA256 equality; no normalization, unexpected escaping, extra whitespace or double hash.
cases.oracle: Fixed hand-inspected tiny strings plus Python json.dumps ensure_ascii=False,separators=(comma,colon),allow_nan=False and hashlib.sha256; compare to raw UTF8 bytes.
cases.baseline_strategy: No canonicalizer exists at baseline: preserve reviewed expected bytes before implementation, not an API-not-found test.

cases.arrange: One valid kind1 event with multiple tags and suffix fields.
cases.actions: Change created_at/kind/content/tag count/tag order/duplicate count/each tag field/selected identity one at a time; separately alter envelope whitespace/key order or equivalent string escapes.
cases.expected: Signed-value mutations cannot reuse authority and have independent expected event IDs; syntax-only equivalents have same event ID but new review still needed for different request/session.
cases.oracle: Independent canonical oracle and committed mutation recipes; expected semantic equivalence chosen before Rust execution.
cases.baseline_strategy: Baseline approval digest comparison is only a precursor; it does not substitute for NIP01 ID evidence.

cases.arrange: Plain note; root-only reply; root+different reply; unmarked e references; p target; q event ID+author and q address with colon-bearing identifier; unknown tag and suffix.
cases.actions: Traverse each complete review; compare typed role/index/value records and overview to independently authored expectations.
cases.expected: Every signed value appears once in indexed review with exact role. Unmarked context says ambiguous; quote/author/relay hints remain unverified. Unknown/extension data is complete and explicitly uninterpreted.
cases.oracle: P01 event-review contract plus exact conservative grammar in brief; expected presentation authored without calling renderer.
cases.baseline_strategy: Capture current generic kind/tag display lacking semantics; no claim that legacy snapshots prove requirements.

cases.arrange: Malformed known e/p/q; invalid curve pubkey; root duplicates/reply duplicates/equal root-reply/reply without root/mixed marked-unmarked; empty tags/identifier; emoji; kinds0,3,5,6,7,10002,10050,22242,16,17,14,13,1059.
cases.actions: Attempt to review each input. URI cases include valid mixed-case DNS/path %HH and empty hints; bad port/IPv4/labels/userinfo/query/fragment/Unicode/IPv6/control/backslash.
cases.expected: Reject unsupported or malformed known semantics before consent, even if raw strings fit. Additional-data path cannot bypass validation. Admitted URI values retain exact bytes.
cases.oracle: Accepted P01 semantics + brief subset rules; explicit negative matrix does not label unsupported valid URIs as globally invalid Nostr.
cases.baseline_strategy: Reproduce arbitrary-kind/empty-tag generic legacy review admission; product signing stays disabled throughout.

cases.arrange: Maximal admitted content/tags, empty strings, long suffix, different display widths/heights including smallest valid geometry.
cases.actions: Collect all generated frames; reconstruct per-field escaped values by indexes; compare to independently encoded values; mutate final suffix after shared prefix.
cases.expected: No omitted field, hidden suffix, ellipsis, collapsed whitespace or ambiguous index; each accepted operation is entirely inspectable. Capacity failure rejects before approval.
cases.oracle: Independent field inventory and reversible inspection-string grammar; comparing only screenshots or author snapshots is insufficient.
cases.baseline_strategy: Reproduce legacy summary renderer truncation while returning Ok; full QR pagination controls identify which prior path already avoided ellipses.

cases.arrange: Literal U+202E versus bidi scalar; literal backslash-u braces versus scalar; literal backslash-n versus newline; zero-width joiner, combining marks, CR, LF, tabs, spaces at boundaries, quote, emoji.
cases.actions: Generate review inspection tokens for each pair and roundtrip with small independent decoder.
cases.expected: Distinct accepted scalar strings have distinct inspection text; canonical signed bytes stay unchanged; escape tokens are not split across frames.
cases.oracle: Explicit ASCII inspection grammar; Unicode TR36 spoofing cases.
cases.baseline_strategy: Reproduce existing U+XXXX and backslash rendering collisions in legacy display_safe_text consumers.

cases.arrange: Multi-page field; local display driver that fails on chosen pages; stale page/generation acknowledgements; early Approve.
cases.actions: Jump logical section, skip scroll windows, replay acknowledgements, fail last data page, reach decision without all frames displayed.
cases.expected: No Approved state until every exact flat page has successful local presentation and acknowledgement plus distinct final consent. Failure/cancel leaves no authority; no generic trusted=true override.
cases.oracle: Handwritten expected traversal state transitions; adversarial local I/O driver explicitly models trusted adapter faults.
cases.baseline_strategy: Capture legacy logical Next skipping scroll windows and approval without current_frame calls; retain baseline output.

cases.arrange: Host envelopes with approved/button/trusted/approval_digest fields; constructed legacy pages; copied transcript; readiness all true.
cases.actions: Route via each host entry; try public API forgery/Clone using compile-fail probes; separately run a valid local review control.
cases.expected: Host fields reject; diagnostic objects cannot convert to authority or supply a key; no exported approved constructor/callback/Clone. Valid local path reaches Approved.
cases.oracle: API surface inspection and negative compile tests supplemented by actual host-entry runtime tests.
cases.baseline_strategy: Direct baseline ApprovalGate can be approved from chosen strings and cloned; distinguish that exposed capability from disabled transport output.

cases.arrange: Approved control operation with pinned request, account/session/policy/limits/review generations and deadline.
cases.actions: Alter one bound value at a time via test-only fault injection, including current identity and generated review data; first attempt then original retry.
cases.expected: Zero backend calls/output on mismatch, grant consumed, retry rejected. Immutable public API prevents normal mutation; private mutation proves fail-closed boundary, not a supported setter.
cases.oracle: Binding inventory and state oracle independent of stored digest; positive same-context call retained.
cases.baseline_strategy: Baseline can_sign only checks request/digest; no session/policy/deadline checks exist.

cases.arrange: Approved operation and private counted backend; success, pre-invocation validation failure, crypto Err, wrong-key/signature return, simulated lost response.
cases.actions: Attempt twice, duplicate consent, retry through other adapter, and new request with reused request ID.
cases.expected: At most one backend invocation per local consent; all outcomes leave Spent. Production unavailable path also consumes. No retry reconstructs output; new attempt needs fresh review.
cases.oracle: Call counter plus independently verified valid signature control; failures never promoted to success.
cases.baseline_strategy: Baseline repeated can_sign returns true and cloned gate repeats it; save this direct behavioral failure.

cases.arrange: Receive/Reviewing/Approved/Executing/Spent states; cancel, reject, lock, reset, deadline, same/different-account replacement, same/different-policy update and limits update.
cases.actions: Cross product meaningful state/event orderings; attempt after every invalidation; inject completion from prior generation.
cases.expected: No stale authority or completion output; locked/reset key owner dropped as applicable. New idle session has no imported consent. A started crypto call cannot be undone but never authorizes a second.
cases.oracle: Explicit transition table in brief; independent reviewer adds ordering cases absent from author table.
cases.baseline_strategy: Legacy gate lacks these transitions; baseline repro demonstrates approved state detached from account/policy objects.

cases.arrange: One actual session behind std::sync::Mutex; two host threads released by barrier; private counted success/failure backend.
cases.actions: Race execute/execute and execute/cancel with both deterministic orderings. Exercise private begin/completion transition with cancellation between them.
cases.expected: At most one attempt authorized. Cancel-before-start yields zero calls; start-before-cancel permits at most one call and stale completion is discarded. No unsynchronized cloned state.
cases.oracle: Explicit schedule and invocation counts, not probability of stress success; Rust exclusive owner contract inspected.
cases.baseline_strategy: Baseline Clone gate demonstrates independent copies, not a claim of a measured interrupt race.

cases.arrange: Old review/page token and request ID retained by hostile host; new owner after reset/reconnect; clock ticks deadline-1/deadline/deadline+1 and rollback; checked counter overflow.
cases.actions: Replay old local event/callback into new session; same public identity selected again; host supplies future timestamps and stalled request retries.
cases.expected: Old authority never resurrects; exact deadline expires; clock rollback/unavailable/overflow rejects and invalidates; no host timestamp or navigation extends deadline.
cases.oracle: Private epoch identity plus ownership model; fake local monotonic clock only, no physical timing proof.
cases.baseline_strategy: No corresponding baseline lifecycle feature exists; use reviewed state oracle rather than fabricated baseline execution.

cases.arrange: Every configured input/content/tag count/fields/field bytes/aggregate/canonical bytes/page count/geometry boundary and one pending slot.
cases.actions: Test below/at/above each independently using smaller trusted test limits where input cap would dominate; long UTF8/escaped expansion; deep malformed arrays; repeated short requests while busy; checked multiplication/addition overflow.
cases.expected: No panic/unbounded allocation/recursion or retained queue growth; reject before write/crypto/approval; operation counters remain within derived configured bound. Record static type sizes and target build only.
cases.oracle: Numerical tuple in brief; independent counting formulas and limits configured locally, never via request JSON.
cases.baseline_strategy: Preserve baseline fixed-limit successes and reproduce depth/grammar weaknesses; no repetition of unrelated S02 suites.

cases.arrange: Default/no_std and std builds; legacy SigningReadiness true/false combinations; host persistent_grants/origin/descriptor; valid fixture locally reviewed via disabled production backend.
cases.actions: Send sign_event through serial/QR adapters; call production attempt twice; inspect exported symbols/features and migrate simulator preview expectations.
cases.expected: Product emits signing_disabled/SigningUnavailable and no signature; first unavailable attempt consumed. Only cfg(test) backend can fixture-sign; no runtime/feature switch bypass. Public preview decisions never accepted as signing permission.
cases.oracle: Source feature/API audit and black-box responses; T01/F01 own old host capability policy replacement.
cases.baseline_strategy: Retain baseline signing_disabled fixture as a control; existing boolean status cannot be treated as proof.

cases.arrange: Independent semantic fixtures with exact derived public keys, canonical bytes, IDs, auxiliary bytes and valid BIP340 signatures; official vectors selected for verifier sanity.
cases.actions: Parse/review/approve fixture through actual S03 owner, private backend signs raw event digest; independent oracle verifies output and correlation. Flip each canonical field, ID byte, signature byte, key or request correlation; include valid wrong-author signature and high-level prehash trap.
cases.expected: Control output matches independent event hash and raw signature under selected identity. Modified/wrong-key/double-hashed/stale-correlated outputs reject. No test accepts agreement between two copies of the same canonicalizer as oracle.
cases.oracle: Pinned upstream BIP340 reference.py with hashlib and separately authored strict JSON serializer; libsecp selected API can cross-check but is not sole canonical oracle.
cases.baseline_strategy: No product signature exists at input; pin expected combined vectors first and record new implementation evidence, without rerunning full S02 provider selection.

oracle_plan.authority: independent protocol semantics and strict parser, not implementation output
oracle_plan.canonicalization: Python standard json with decoded-name duplicate hook, lexeme-aware nonnegative parse_int, reject parse_float/parse_constant, strict UTF8 and surrogate rejection, exact member/types/ranges; serialize array with ensure_ascii=False,separators=(comma,colon),allow_nan=False; hash with hashlib.sha256. Hand inspect small bytes and escape-specific cases.
oracle_plan.signatures: Use hash-pinned upstream BIP340 reference.py public fixture sign/verify, preserving BSD/MIT/CC0 applicable provenance; no private cryptographic implementation. Actual S03 fixture path uses k256 sign_raw on the 32-byte NIP01 digest. Test selected official vectors to establish verifier sanity; do not rerun S02 broad provider campaign.
oracle_plan.fixtures: Commit small original nSealr semantic/hostile vectors after independent generation, include generator/source/input/output hashes. Never regenerate expected values from observed Rust output during --check. Reference source is fetched/hash-checked or licensed selected copy with provenance; no private histories.
oracle_plan.independent_review: Reviewer executes independent oracle against exact final candidate, adds hostile transitions/mutations and inspects both specification adequacy and API bypasses.

preparatory_tiny_canonical_example.provenance: BIP340 scalar 3 x-only public key; manually concatenated NIP01 array, hashlib digest computed during preparation. Not a product acceptance test.
